answer: The fee is charged through a summit debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the knoll totals, and the trellis anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 47 units per epoch, sustaining 252 aliases for 20 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 3 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
